items.headline: Tesla and SpaceX form special committees to study a merger
items.summary: Musk said committees of independent directors at both companies will study a combination (about $3.6T combined value at current valuations). He is excluded from direct negotiations as a conflicted party and said there is no guarantee terms will be reached. US approval would need a majority of all Tesla shares.
